description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for the '--anchored' feature of 'git diff' and related commands. It defines various test cases to verify the behavior of diff generation with anchored lines in different scenarios, including multiple anchors, nonexistent anchor lines, non-unique lines, and interaction with other commands like 'git show'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a sequence of commands, and verifies their outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific expected code.
